mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM articles WHERE title = #{title}) AS title_exists, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM articles WHERE slug = #{slug}) AS slug_exists
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO articles ( writers_id, title, slug, subtitle, summary, md_desc, image_ids ) VALUES ( #{writersId}, #{title}, #{slug}, #{subtitle}, #{summary}, #{mdDesc}, #{imageIdsStr} )
mapper.update: UPDATE articles SET writers_id = #{writersId}, title = #{title}, slug = #{slug}, subtitle = #{subtitle}, summary = #{summary}, md_desc = #{mdDesc}, image_ids = #{imageIdsStr} WHERE id = #{articleId}
mapper.delete: UPDATE articles SET deleted = TRUE WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM articles WHERE deleted IS FALSE ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM articles WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted IS FALSE
